list.titleFormat: ara API unreachable - exporter served stale data here

links.title: ARA Prometheus docs
links.tooltip: Documentation for the ara prometheus exporter and its metrics

links.title: Open ara
links.tooltip: Open the ara web UI this dashboard is reading from

links.title: Failed playbooks
links.tooltip: Open the playbooks that failed during the selected range in the ara web UI

links.title: Failed tasks
links.tooltip: Open the tasks that failed during the selected range in the ara web UI

links.title: Failed hosts
links.tooltip: Open the hosts with at least one failed result since the range start in the ara web UI

panels.title: Playbooks
panels.description: New playbooks in the selected range, with how many failed.

panels.title: Tasks
panels.description: New tasks in the selected range, with how many failed.

panels.title: Results
panels.description: New task results in the selected range, with failed and unreachable counts. Excludes results with ignore_errors=True.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: New host records (one per host x playbook) in the selected range (total), plus failed and unreachable result counts summed across hosts from the per-hostname breakdown.

panels.title: Playbook outcomes
panels.description: Composition of playbooks that ran in the selected range, each slice labelled with its status and share.

panels.title: Playbooks by status
panels.description: New playbooks per interval as stacked bars, split by status. Overlaid as a line on the right axis is the number of playbooks 'running'.

panels.title: Tasks by status
panels.description: New tasks per interval as stacked bars, split by status. Overlaid as a line on the right axis is the number of tasks 'running'.

panels.title: Playbook durations
panels.description: Percentiles of playbook durations over the specified range window.

panels.title: Task durations
panels.description: Percentiles of task durations over the specified range window.

panels.title: Results by status
panels.description: New task results per interval as stacked bars split by ara's derived status.

panels.title: Top hosts by changed results
panels.description: New changed task results per interval stacked by host for the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum by (hostname) (clamp_min(delta(ara_hosts_by_hostname{status="changed"}[$__interval]), 0)) and on(hostname) (topk(10, sum by (hostname) (clamp_min(delta(ara_hosts_by_hostname{status="changed"}[$__range]), 0))) > 0.5)

panels.title: Top hosts by failed / unreachable results
panels.description: New failed and unreachable results (combined) per interval stacked by host. An empty panel means nothing failed or went unreachable in the selected window.

targets.expr: sum by (hostname) (clamp_min(delta(ara_hosts_by_hostname{status=~"failed|unreachable"}[$__interval]), 0)) and on(hostname) (topk(10, sum by (hostname) (clamp_min(delta(ara_hosts_by_hostname{status=~"failed|unreachable"}[$__range]), 0))) > 0.5)

panels.title: Playbooks by controller
panels.description: Where playbooks are being run from, per interval.

panels.title: Playbooks by user
panels.description: Who is running playbooks, per interval.

panels.title: Playbooks by Ansible version
panels.description: Which Ansible versions are running, per interval.

panels.title: Playbooks by Python version
panels.description: Which Python versions the controllers ran Ansible under, per interval.

panels.title: ara API reachable
panels.description: UP when the exporter could reach ara on the last refresh, DOWN otherwise. When DOWN the exporter serves the last good data, so the activity panels flatline; the ara_up == 0 annotation shades that window. The annotation can be toggled at the top of the dashboard.

panels.title: Scrape errors
panels.description: Refreshes that failed to collect from ara over the selected range.

panels.title: Metrics age
panels.description: Age of the cached metrics being served (grows if background refreshes start failing).

panels.title: Refresh duration
panels.description: Time the last background refresh spent querying ara and building metrics.

panels.title: Scrape & refresh duration
panels.description: Time to answer each scrape (served from cache, so near-zero) versus the time each background refresh spends building metrics from ara.
